Hello! In this simulation we need to test brain activity...
You will need to complete all levels to finish the simulation

1. Buy upgrade
2. Reset upgrade but increase its value

It's quite simple. Control like on a real PC - WASD
Remember, you need to complete all levels
Great! You've completed everything... We will now begin extracting your consciousness from VR II...

The Colonel won't be pleased... I have bad news - you're stuck here forever... Outside the simulation, you're just a piece of meat... Like sleeping with your eyes open. The only place where your brain shows activity is the simulation.
We've named this incident [shake rate=15 level=10][color=red]'DEAD BRAIN'[/color][/shake]

Do you want to continue the simulation or die completely?...
